name: @barty13/pi-opencode-bridge
description: Delegate threads to a local OpenCode service from Pi. oc_open returns at once, the thread settling opens a later turn.
author: Barty <Barty13@users.noreply.github.com>

scripts.check: bun run checks/make-controls.ts && for c in 4xx 5xx nowatch expire stale dup ceiling handle flush streamgap envparse perms loopback known askfail rootfile ceilenv abortlist panemode busyexp expirepane reply kill readbounds; do CASE=$c bun run checks/check-3-unit.ts || exit 1; done && CASE=stale sh checks/run-control.sh .control-bridge.ts url bun run checks/check-3-unit.ts && CASE=dup sh checks/run-control.sh .control-bridge.ts url bun run checks/check-3-unit.ts && bun run checks/check-1-compact.ts && sh checks/run-control.sh .control-compact.ts url bun run checks/check-1-compact.ts && bun run checks/check-4-gate.ts && sh checks/run-control.sh .control-nogate.ts path bun run checks/check-4-gate.ts && bun run checks/check-6-digest.ts && sh checks/run-control.sh .control-digest.ts path bun run checks/check-6-digest.ts && bun run checks/check-7-steer.ts && sh checks/run-control.sh .control-steer.ts path bun run checks/check-7-steer.ts && bun run checks/check-8-attach.ts && sh checks/run-control.sh .control-attach.ts path bun run checks/check-8-attach.ts && bun run checks/check-9-rewind.ts && sh checks/run-control.sh .control-rewind.ts path bun run checks/check-9-rewind.ts && bun run checks/check-10-budget.ts && sh checks/run-control.sh .control-budget.ts path bun run checks/check-10-budget.ts && bun run checks/check-11-fanout.ts && sh checks/run-control.sh .control-fanout.ts path bun run checks/check-11-fanout.ts && bun run checks/check-12-docs.ts && sh checks/run-control.sh .control-docs.ts path bun run checks/check-12-docs.ts && bun run checks/check-13-panes.ts
